newsitem.title: USA: Cylink sees Q4 charge of $0.01-$0.02/shr.
newsitem.headline: Cylink sees Q4 charge of $0.01-$0.02/shr.

text.p: Cylink Corp said it expects to take a one-time restructuring charge of $0.01 to $0.02 per share in the fourth quarter ending December 31, 1996, in part due to the release of six senior executives.

The reorganization of senior management removes several positions while also adding several managers. It follows the appointment of Fernand Sarrat as the company's new president and chief executive last month.

Cylink will be organized into two business units: The Wireless Technology business, headed by incumbent vice president and general manager Stephen Goldberg, and the Information Security business, which will report directly to Sarrat.
